title: The Insane Story Behind Japan's First Supercar
description:
In the early nineteen sixties, Japanese cars were widely seen as cheap and second-rate. A few years later, one of them broke thirteen world records in seventy-two hours, won races, starred opposite James Bond, and lost its maker money on every sale. This is the story behind Japan's first supercar, the Toyota 2000GT, and the places where our sources tell it differently. Our sources are Wikipedia's page on the Toyota 2000GT and its pages on the Nissan S30 and Z-car, a March twenty twenty-one report by MotorPress, BusinessDay in South Africa, Toyota's UK magazine, Classic and Sports Car, Hagerty, Shannons Club and Sports Car Market. They disagree on names, dates and counts, and we show the disagreements. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

12:42 Bond
13:53 The price of fame
15:40 After the end
19:56 The South African survivor
21:13 The surprising ending
23:00 What the sources do not say
